tables.title: Moves
rows: The fight opens with it climbing out of the ground、and for roughly the first three 秒onds of that animation it can't be targeted or damaged. Get into position、hold your cooldowns until it's fully out.
Every melee combo opens with this wide arm swing、which has only light knockback. It always rolls into a 秒ond swing、so don't stay in front of it after the first hit.
One of the two possible 秒ond swings. It does the same damage as the opener with six times the knockback、so a hit sends you flying.
The other possible finisher、its hardest melee hit、with the same heavy knockback as the follow swipe.

Unlocked at 70% health、used whenever its 20-second cooldown is up、often straight after a swipe combo. For six 秒onds it chases its target、battering everything nearby through walls、deflecting every projectile、so hold your shots、keep clear until it stops、then punish the wind-down.

After a windup of about a 秒ond、a half it fires a fast blast straight along its facing that knocks you back、leaves a line of soul puddles for 6 秒onds、each inflicting Soulsick. Sidestep out of the line instead of backing down it、and don't hug it either、because the blast also shoves away anyone close.
Three more booms follow the first、0.3 秒onds apart、and it turns back toward its target as they start. Keep moving sideways until the third has passed.
Six slow soul orbs fan out as the sonic boom fires、begin homing in after a brief delay. They burst on terrain、so ducking behind cover gets rid of them.

Used at most once every 15 秒onds、and only when you're close enough. After a short charge-up it spews souls: anyone near its mouth is hit、knocked back、减速、and all 19 floor patches in the arena turn into Soulsick pools for 10 秒onds、so learn the patch layout、step off them before the charge ends.

From 90% health down it roars in two or three Skeletons、up to one Flame Construct、two to six Excavators、never more than eight at once、on a 15-second cooldown. Every summoned mob yields 20 souls more than usual (24 for an Excavator or Flame Construct、28 for the Skeletons)、so the adds double as a soul refill.
Breaking its 800 poise stuns it for 8.8 秒onds. As it gets back up it drops a Soulsick puddle just in front of itself that lasts 7 秒onds、so don't linger at its feet as the stun ends.
